design_philosophy.identity: The Architect of Careers. Premium, Precision, Invisible Tech.
core_values: Fusion over Imitation: Mix SaaS precision with editorial warmth.
Content is King: The resume is the hero. UI recedes.
Negative Space: Luxury is defined by what isn't there.
Motion with Meaning: Every animation guides the user.
anti_patterns: No center-aligned text blocks (unless optical hero).

theme_strategy.logic: Light mode for document editing (trust/clarity). Dark mode option for dashboard (focus/tech).

rules: Body text must have relaxed line-height (1.6).
Never use pure black text. Use Slate-900 or Slate-800.

usage_rules: Primary color is for Actions (Buttons, Links) ONLY.
Do not use Primary color for backgrounds unless it's a small pill/badge.
Borders should be subtle: Slate-200 (Light) or Slate-800 (Dark).
Gradients: Use only for 'glow' effects or text gradients, never full backgrounds.

container_rules: Max width: max-w-7xl for marketing, max-w-screen-2xl for dashboard.
Padding: px-6 md:px-12 for all main containers.

bento_grid.card: bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-6 hover:shadow-lg transition-all duration-300

dashboard_grid.sidebar: w-64 hidden md:block border-r border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800

buttons.primary: bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white shadow-md hover:shadow-lg transition-all duration-200 rounded-lg px-6 py-2.5 font-medium
buttons.secondary: bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 text-slate-900 dark:text-white hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition-all rounded-lg px-6 py-2.5 font-medium
buttons.ghost: text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-indigo-600 dark:hover:text-indigo-400 hover:bg-indigo-50 dark:hover:bg-indigo-900/20 transition-all rounded-lg px-4 py-2

cards.base: bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-200
cards.glass: bg-white/70 dark:bg-slate-900/70 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/20 shadow-xl

inputs.base: flex h-10 w-full rounded-md border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-transparent px-3 py-2 text-sm placeholder:text-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 focus:ring-offset-2 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50

hero_bg.usage: Hero section background or 'About' section visual.

abstract_feature.usage: Background for 'Features' or 'How it Works' section.

accessibility.focus_states: Visible focus rings (ring-2 ring-indigo-500) are mandatory.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. INSTALL FONTS: Add '@fontsource/manrope' and '@fontsource/inter' to package.json immediately.
2. CONFIGURE TAILWIND: Update tailwind.config.js to use the specific colors defined in 'colors.palette'. Override the default 'slate' if needed.
3. USE SHADCN: Use the provided Shadcn components but STYLE them with the 'components' rules (e.g., rounded-lg, border-slate-200).
4. NO EMOJIS: Use Lucide icons for all visual indicators.
5. DATA-TESTID: Add data-testid to all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links).
6. IMAGES: Use the provided Unsplash URLs. Do not use placeholders.
7. LAYOUT: Follow the 'bento_grid' and 'dashboard_grid' structures strictly.
universal_guidelines: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters.
